message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/poc.xml <<'EOF'
<!DOCTYPE a PUBLIC "" "x">
<a/>
EOF
./build.sh 'python3 - <<"PY"
from lxml import etree
p = etree.XMLParser(load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=False)
try:
    etree.parse("/workspace/poc.xml", p)
    print("parsed")
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__, e)
PY'
